title: Dependence of the gap parameter on the number of CuO2 layers in a unit cell of optimally doped BSCCO, TBCCO, HBCCO and HSCCO
abstract: We have measured the superconducting gap Ds in optimally doped samples of BSCCO, TBCCO, HBCCO and HSCCO by Andreev and tunnelling spectroscopy and by ARPES. We have found that the low-temperature value of the gap within experimental errors is linearly increasing with the number n of CuO2 layers in the unit cell of the investigated HTSC-families (n < 4)
